criteria.notes: Only presentation=compact is recognized; property omission and native attribute removal both restore undefined and retain the legacy path.

criteria.description: Absent-axis consumers retain the existing slots, parts, three-column layout, and 720px legacy reflow.
criteria.evidence: fixtures/elements-behaviour/src/sk-app-shell.test.ts; apps/storybook/src/tests/sk-team-overview-shell-layout.spec.ts
criteria.notes: The two compact regions are inert additions and default desktop/narrow behavior remains unchanged.

criteria.description: Unknown presentation values warn once and fail open to the legacy layout.
criteria.evidence: unknown-presentation and native-removal behavior tests in fixtures/elements-behaviour/src/sk-app-shell.test.ts
criteria.notes: Unknown strings still warn and fail open; native omission does not emit an unknown-null warning. Legacy personal, context, and content regions remain visible.

criteria.description: Pre-upgrade presentation, open, and property-only trigger assignments survive definition.
criteria.evidence: [SC-010] pre-upgrade/reflection and native-attribute-removal fixtures plus generated React/Vue type tests
criteria.notes: presentation/open reflect; declarative presentation authoring upgrades; removed presentation normalizes to undefined; compactTrigger never serializes.

criteria.description: Compact mode exposes a consumer-authored compact-header without duplicating main.
criteria.evidence: element slot-order tests and compact Storybook axe/landmark test
criteria.notes: Exactly one main remains in the shell shadow tree.

criteria.description: Compact mode exposes a consumer-authored native compact-navigation region.
criteria.evidence: element projection tests and Chromium/Firefox compact stories
criteria.notes: The shell adds no navigation landmark or route behavior.

criteria.description: Compact placement is inclusive through an app-shell content inline size of 860px; 861px is noncompact.
criteria.evidence: [SC-017] element tests and 390/768/860/861 Playwright cases
criteria.notes: CSS and ResizeObserver use the same content-box coordinate.

criteria.description: Drawer rendering follows consumer-controlled open and the shell never mutates the value.
criteria.evidence: [SC-010] mutation-backed controlled-open tests
criteria.notes: Escape emits intent; the consumer accepts or rejects it.

criteria.description: The public contract keeps trigger, IDREF, target, expanded state, and accessible labels consumer-owned in one light-DOM root.
criteria.evidence: same-root/actual-slot tests; docs/design-system/using-components.md
criteria.notes: False slot attributes, cross-shell targets, and cross-root targets are rejected.

criteria.description: Closed navigation is inert and absent from focus/accessibility order; open navigation follows native order.
criteria.evidence: [SC-012] element fixtures and Chromium/Firefox accessibility-tree tests
criteria.notes: hidden, inert, aria-hidden, sequential focus, and focus release on a true-to-false controlled close are asserted together.

criteria.description: One effectively-open Escape emits exactly one typed, bubbling, composed, non-cancelable dismissal; all other states emit none.
criteria.evidence: [SC-006]/[SC-007]/[SC-008] element fixtures and compact Playwright Escape coverage
criteria.notes: Absent, unknown, noncompact, and controlled-closed cases emit zero.

criteria.description: Accepted dismissal renders closed before connected valid-trigger focus return; rejected intent cannot steal later focus.
criteria.evidence: [SC-012] accepted/rejected/disconnected/slot/root fixtures in the native and React browser layers
criteria.notes: Review-cycle false-slot/cross-root and ordinary-close findings have dedicated regressions. Parent-head evidence shows a real stateful React 19 consumer scheduling a false-or-omitted controlled value that exactly one bounded microtask samples as effective falsiness; the component then awaits its Lit update before returning focus. The intent expires at that sample whether accepted or rejected, so a later route/state close cannot inherit it. Successor exact-SHA gates and independent approval remain pending.

criteria.description: Consumer route activation can close by changing open without shell routing or destination state.
criteria.evidence: native pointer/keyboard route-close Playwright story
criteria.notes: Ordinary route close releases focus from newly hidden navigation without restoring compactTrigger.

criteria.description: Open compact navigation is viewport-bounded and owns vertical scrolling.
criteria.evidence: short/tall/long-label Playwright cases and four headed UI-zoom captures
criteria.notes: At 400%, Chromium measured 157/334 and Firefox 155/334 client/scroll height.

criteria.description: Required widths and real 200%/400% browser UI zoom avoid page overflow and preserve long labels.
criteria.evidence: 38-case Chromium/Firefox suite; docs/architecture/validation/issue-254-compact-navigation/*.png
criteria.notes: Headed XTEST zoom used exact DPR 2/4, exact 390 CSS viewport, and visualViewport.scale=1.

criteria.description: Threshold resize preserves open while reconciling visibility, focus, accessibility exposure, and expanded claims.
criteria.evidence: bidirectional resize and compact-to-legacy focus-cleanup tests
criteria.notes: Both header and drawer focus paths are covered.

criteria.description: Default dark, LightMode, forced-colors, and reduced-motion modes preserve usable state and focus.
criteria.evidence: mode stories, token-surface comparison, forced-colors outline, reduced-motion timing assertions
criteria.notes: The contract does not depend on hover, animation, color, or a glyph alone.

criteria.description: Focused stories cover desktop, closed/open compact, widths, long labels, heights, and accessibility modes.
criteria.evidence: packages/elements/src/app-shell/sk-app-shell.stories.ts; expected-stories.json; Storybook build
criteria.notes: Includes the exact required LightMode story name.

criteria.description: Behavior, accessibility, responsive, axe, and mutation coverage exercise every behavior-bearing branch.
criteria.evidence: focused Vitest/Playwright, axe, full tests, cycle-4 isolated SC-010 proof, cycle-5/6 isolated arms, the complete 210-arm suite-selftest, and guard selftest
criteria.notes: All 210 registered arms produced their named red from a 471-assertion green baseline with 128 registry pairs, 41 impacted sources, zero fallback, and no runner fault on the post-#264 diagnostic candidate. The immutable PR/issue evidence pins the mandatory replay to the final reviewed SHA after this tracked ledger is frozen.

criteria.description: Documentation publishes the complete public slot/property/event/part and consumer ownership contract.
criteria.evidence: docs/design-system/using-components.md; custom-elements manifest docs; validation ledger
criteria.notes: Threshold, focus timing, disconnected trigger, route ownership, and same-root IDREF obligations are explicit.

criteria.description: Behavior/mutation registries and CSS, manifest, React, Vue, ratchet, story, and size outputs are synchronized by generators.
criteria.evidence: CEM/React/Vue/CSS/markup regeneration and checks; post-#264 Node 24 no-cache elements build and authoritative size generation
criteria.notes: Post-#264 source regeneration is clean. The nullable property-reset metadata derives the React wrapper from the manifest rather than hand-editing it, and Node 24 authoritative size generation records the resulting release bytes. Final check-mode hashes are recorded externally against the reviewed delivery SHA.
